headline: Stlican Shelf Reignites as Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm Battle On
war_summary: Strategic base clashes have flared anew across Stlican Shelf while violent turnover continues unabated across Weathered Expanse and Palantine Berm. Over the last two hours, Stlican Shelf recorded five base exchanges centered on Briar and Breaker Town, shattering its earlier lull. Weathered Expanse remains the war's most volatile sector, logging thirteen strategic base transitions and over 2,400 casualties in two hours, leaving three positions reduced to neutral no-man's-land. In Palantine Berm, ten base changes unfolded across The Droll and The Pippeli Stones as both armies grapple for control. Conversely, direct base turnover in Stonecradle has quieted following earlier contests at The Reach and World's End. Across other central sectors, severe attritional combat persists without recent strategic changes: Callahan's Passage suffered nearly 4,400 casualties over the past two hours, while Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy endure heavy artillery exchanges and steady enlistments.
